verdict.rationale: Foreloop's feedback widget triages submissions (real vs spam) and its agent automatically reads a submission to create/fill an 'intention' and propose tasks, which is a form of automatic feedback-to-idea linkage (foreloop-docs-9,10,11,20,21). However, there is no evidence of cross-feedback insight aggregation or explicit linking of multiple feedback items to existing feature ideas/roadmap entries, only per-submission intention creation. Missing for 10: evidence of detecting recurring themes/insights across multiple feedback submissions, and of associating them with existing feature ideas rather than just spawning new intentions.
